facts.fact: Hill-post lore Ila learned as a chain-girl: cairn-light that dims slowly means a road no pair has walked in a generation, which the jogini let go; light pinched out all at once means its cairn has been pulled down or a stone lifted. Who pulled down the cairn at the fourth light's fold is left open (Raghu's men or someone else). Needs a bible ruling on what extinguishes cairn-light.

Revises F445: Ila's east bearing is left off her field book at the end of ch 3 with it unclear whether her cold hands failed or she chose; her first spoken, deliberate omission is reserved for the night Kunal shows her the route (F498, worksheet trust choice 1).
